title: The Distribution of the Deepest Leaves in Binary Trees
summary: We study the extreme local structure of plane binary trees through the limiting distribution of the number of leaves at maximum depth. For every $m\geq1$, we determine the limiting probability $κ^{[m]}$ that the deepest level contains $2m$ leaves. The resulting sequence is encoded by a generating function $K(y)$, obtained from a bivariate refinement of the Catalan iteration. We show that, at the critical point of this iteration, a parabolic recurrence governs the marked generating functions.
